description: Implementation of the Buffer11 class and related buffer storage classes for Direct3D 11 in ANGLE, handling GPU and CPU buffer management, including mapping, resizing, copying, and resource views.

classes.name: Buffer11
classes.description: Main class managing D3D11 buffers and their storage variants, including creation, resizing, copying, mapping, and resource view management.

classes.name: Buffer11::BufferStorage
classes.description: Abstract base class for different buffer storage types, managing data revision, size, and usage.

classes.name: Buffer11::NativeStorage
classes.description: Represents a native D3D11 buffer resource with methods for copying, resizing, mapping, and resource view creation.

classes.name: Buffer11::EmulatedIndexedStorage
classes.description: Stores expanded index data for emulating indexed buffers, used for specific rendering scenarios.

classes.name: Buffer11::PackStorage
classes.description: Handles CPU memory for pack buffers, including asynchronous texture readback and pixel packing.

classes.name: Buffer11::SystemMemoryStorage
classes.description: Stores buffer data in CPU memory for dynamic updates, avoiding GPU resource overhead.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data, resizing storage if necessary.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves buffer data from system memory storage.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a portion of the buffer with new data.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer, handling staging and GPU resources.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps buffer memory for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps buffer memory after CPU access.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the underlying D3D11 buffer resource.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer storage, preserving data if specified.

methods.name: copyFromStorage
methods.description: Copies data from another storage, possibly recreating the buffer.

methods.name: getSRVForFormat
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a shader resource view for the buffer.

methods.name: getRawUAV
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an unordered access view for raw buffer access.
